<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/inventory-replenishment">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_InventoryReplenishment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_InventoryProcess" name="Inventory replenishment" processRef="Process_InventoryReplenishment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Suppliers" name="Suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PurchaseOrder" name="Purchase order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Participant_Suppliers"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryReplenishment" name="Inventory replenishment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BeginMonitoring" name="Begin monitoring inventory"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ThresholdReached" name="Threshold reached?" default="Flow_ThresholdNotReached"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAlert" name="Generate automated reorder alert"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Perform manual check"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeReorderSignals" name="Reorder need signaled"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with supplier"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update expected delivery dates in inventory system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveStock" name="Receive stock"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock quality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StoreStock" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels after restock"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RestockComplete" name="Restock complete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToMonitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_BeginMonitoring" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToThreshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdReached" name="Threshold reached" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached" targetRef="Gateway_ReorderMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock level at or below predefined threshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdNotReached" name="Threshold not reached" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AutomatedAlert" name="Automated alert" sourceRef="Gateway_ReorderMethod" targetRef="Task_GenerateAlert">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">automated alert is used</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReorderMethod" name="Signal reorder need"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ManualCheck" name="Manual check" sourceRef="Gateway_ReorderMethod" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlertToMerge" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAlert" targetRef="Gateway_MergeReorderSignals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_MergeReorderSignals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeReorderSignals" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToDeliveryUpdate" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryUpdateToReceive" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToInspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStock" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectToRecord" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToStore" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Task_StoreStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StoreToInventoryUpdate" sourceRef="Task_StoreStock" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InventoryUpdateToEnd" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_RestockComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
